stories.title: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share, above target range
new_facts: Anthropic IPO priced at $83 a share, raising a record $81.3 billion.
Anthropic scheduled to begin trading Thursday; IPO framed as affecting 401(k) retirement savings.
Valuation is well above $1 trillion at the $83 price.
Debut valuation put at more than $1.4 trillion.
Ticker is ANT on Nasdaq; the offering is the largest on record, topping SpaceX.
Seven Anthropic founders are set to become multi-billionaires through the IPO.
IPO to create thousands of paper millionaires among current and former employees.
Retail investor enthusiasm reportedly rivals the SpaceX debut.
IPO priced above the target range; Anthropic is the first frontier lab to IPO.
Reportedly values Anthropic at $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.
stories.line: Anthropic has priced its IPO at $83 a share, above its target range, with trading set to begin Thursday.

stories.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang steps down as CEO; Colette Kress named interim leader
new_facts: Huang has left as Nvidia CEO; Colette Kress is interim CEO; Microsoft's Nadella voiced confidence in her.
Kress held an all-hands meeting; Huang's exit followed his indiscretions, which she sought to put behind the company.
Kress told staff 'let's move forward' and offered pay raises at the first all-hands since Huang's exit.
Huang is reportedly manoeuvring for a return to Nvidia; pay rises are being accelerated.
stories.line: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid reports of affairs, one with an executive US officials believe is a Chinese spy; interim CEO Colette Kress now leads.

stories.title: Pennsylvania records eighth measles death as US loses elimination status
new_facts: Unvaccinated Pennsylvania resident died, the eighth measles death of 2026, a day after the US lost its 26-year measles elimination status.
RFK Jr. under fire for telling a Lancaster Amish community the measles cure is "chicken soup"; 2021 footage resurfaced.
stories.line: An unvaccinated Pennsylvania resident died of measles, the state's eighth measles death this year, days after the US lost its elimination status.

stories.title: Maryland teens sue after AI mistakes Doritos bag for gun, police detain them
new_facts: Four students filed a lawsuit a year after the incident against Omnilert, Baltimore County police and the school board.
Names Taki Allen, 16, at Kenwood High on Oct 20, 2025; at least six police vehicles; Omnilert Gun Detect.
stories.line: Four Maryland high school students were handcuffed by police after an AI gun-detection system mistook a Doritos bag for a weapon, and they are suing.

stories.title: NYC, LA and Chicago schools weigh dropping Google Search over AI
new_facts: NYC, LA and Chicago school districts weigh dropping Google Search after Google refused to unbundle AI features for students.
stories.line: Large US school districts are weighing dropping Google Search over its AI features, which critics say are being pushed on schools.

stories.title: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first three-way summit in Shenzhen amid nuclear talks
new_facts: Trilateral Trump-Xi-Putin summit set for Shenzhen, China; US-North Korea meeting now described as uncertain.
Putin brought nuclear briefcase; trilateral agenda reportedly covers limiting nuclear weapons and ending the Ukraine war.
China's arsenal doubled from 300 warheads in 2020 to over 600; New START expired Feb. 5.
Kremlin TV filmed a Russian naval officer carrying the Cheget nuclear briefcase a day before the trilateral meeting.
H.R. McMaster says Putin and Xi see the US as weak, decadent and divided.
Trump and Putin to hold a one-on-one meeting in China on Thursday, covering Ukraine and post-war security guarantees.
stories.line: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen on nuclear arms and security; no joint statement is assured.

stories.title: Senate panel advances Trump FCC pick 15-0 as Democrats boycott
new_facts: Senate committee approved Trump's FCC nominee Thumann 15-0 as Democrats boycotted, alleging he lied about not working on media issues.
Carr says he has the votes on the three-member FCC to repeal the 1934 ban on state cellphone jamming in prisons.
Thune said it is an "open question" whether Senate Republicans have the votes for the Trump administration's large defense package.
All 14 committee Republicans, including Thune, attended; about a dozen Democratic chairs sat empty; the nominee is Carr's adviser.
Cornyn blocked Trump's nominee T. Elliot Gaiser, head of DOJ's Office of Legal Counsel, for a Dallas-area federal district court seat.
Cruz and outgoing Sen. Cornyn shouted at each other on the Senate floor over the blocked judicial nominee; Cornyn said "I don't find you credible."
Cornyn withheld support for Gaiser's Judiciary Committee hearing, a setback as Trump races to confirm judges before Democrats take the Senate.
stories.line: Senate Republicans confirmed a Trump FCC nominee in committee without Democrats, who say she misled senators about her work for Chairman Carr.

stories.title: US indicts Russian national accused of spying on Palantir for Moscow
new_facts: Russian national charged with spying on a Silicon Valley defense contractor over its aid to Ukraine
DOJ names defendant Igor D'iu, indicted by a federal grand jury after covertly traveling to the US
Company identified as Palantir; defendant allegedly stalked and harassed workers over Ukraine's use of its software
Charges include conspiracy to act as a foreign agent; D'iu allegedly entered the US unlawfully
Affidavit says D'iu bought laptops, remote-access software and phones, and sat in a Palo Alto coffee shop near Palantir HQ
Prosecutors say D'iu entered the US from Mexico
stories.line: A Russian national was indicted in the US for allegedly acting as a Russian agent, spying on Palantir and its workers over its work for Ukraine.

stories.title: Israeli forces cross 'yellow line' into central Gaza, first since October ceasefire
new_facts: Israel shared an Al Jazeera video of Palestinians swimming to downplay winter storm hardships in Gaza.
Israeli tanks crossed the yellow line into central Gaza along Salah al-Din road, the first such ground operation since the October ceasefire.
The IDF says it is dismantling a terror tunnel; Hamas calls the incursion a flagrant ceasefire violation.
An Israeli settler killed a Palestinian grandmother in the occupied West Bank.
stories.line: Israeli forces crossed the 'yellow line' into Hamas-controlled central Gaza, the first such incursion since the October ceasefire.

stories.title: Musk says he feels foolish after spending nearly $500M backing losing GOP midterm candidates
new_facts: At DealBook, Musk said he feels "pretty foolish" after spending nearly $500M backing Republicans in midterms Democrats won, and "I'm not MAGA".
Musk distanced himself from MAGA while travelling with Trump, 80, to Shenzhen, China; described as the first trillionaire.
Skydance CEO David Ellison called reports that Trump pushed for Rush Hour 4 "made-up stories", saying an executive started the talks.
stories.line: Elon Musk says he regrets nearly $500M backing Republicans in midterms that Democrats won, and denies being MAGA.
